```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(writexl)
library(car)
library(rstatix)
library(ggpubr)
library(forcats)
library(here)

run_name          <- params$run_name
output_dir        <- params$output_dir
this_study_label  <- params$this_study_label
prefix            <- paste0(run_name, "_")

dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

## 1. Load Data

```{r load-data}
df <- read_excel(here("data", "gmwi2_scores.xlsx"), sheet = "gmwi2")
head(df)

# Reorder: study cohort first
target_name <- grep(this_study_label, unique(df$Population),
                    value = TRUE, ignore.case = TRUE)

if (length(target_name) > 0) {
  df$Population <- fct_relevel(df$Population, target_name)
  cat("Reference population placed first:", target_name, "\n")
} else {
  warning("No population matching '", this_study_label, "' found.")
}

cat("Populations:", paste(levels(df$Population), collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("Total samples:", nrow(df), "\n")
```

## 2. Descriptive Statistics

```{r descriptive}
stats <- df %>%
  group_by(Population) %>%
  summarise(
    N        = n(),
    Mean     = mean(GMWI2, na.rm = TRUE),
    SD       = sd(GMWI2, na.rm = TRUE),
    Median   = median(GMWI2, na.rm = TRUE),
    Q1       = quantile(GMWI2, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    Q3       = quantile(GMWI2, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    Min      = min(GMWI2, na.rm = TRUE),
    Max      = max(GMWI2, na.rm = TRUE),
    variance = var(`GMWI2`, na.rm = TRUE),
    coef_var = SD / Mean,
    .groups  = "drop"
  )

knitr::kable(stats, digits = 3,
             caption = "Descriptive Statistics of GMWI2 by Population")
write_xlsx(stats,
           file.path(output_dir, paste0(prefix, "GMWI2_descriptive_stats.xlsx")))
```

## 3. Boxplot

```{r boxplot, fig.width=8, fig.height=6}
p_box <- ggplot(df, aes(x = Population, y = GMWI2, fill = Population)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = 21, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, alpha = 0.5, size = 1.5) +
  labs(title = "Distribution of GMWI2 Across Populations",
       x = "Population", y = "GMWI2 Score") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position  = "none",
        plot.title       = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
        axis.text.x      = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

print(p_box)
ggsave(file.path(output_dir, paste0(prefix, "GMWI2_boxplot_by_population.png")),
       p_box, width = 7, height = 6, dpi = 300)
```

## 4. Statistical Testing

```{r stats-test}
# Normality (Shapiro-Wilk per group)
normality_test <- df %>%
  group_by(Population) %>%
  shapiro_test(GMWI2)
knitr::kable(normality_test, digits = 4,
             caption = "Shapiro-Wilk Normality Test")

# Levene's test
levene_result <- leveneTest(GMWI2 ~ Population, data = df)
cat("Levene's test p-value:", levene_result$`Pr(>F)`[1], "\n")

all_normal   <- all(normality_test$p > 0.05)
homogeneous  <- levene_result$`Pr(>F)`[1] > 0.05

if (all_normal && homogeneous) {
  # ANOVA
  anova_result <- aov(GMWI2 ~ Population, data = df)
  cat("\nUsing: One-way ANOVA\n")
  print(summary(anova_result))

  tukey        <- TukeyHSD(anova_result)
  posthoc_df   <- as.data.frame(tukey$Population)
  write_xlsx(posthoc_df,
             file.path(output_dir, paste0(prefix, "GMWI2_ANOVA_Tukey.xlsx")))
  pairwise_results <- posthoc_df %>%
    rownames_to_column("comparison") %>%
    separate(comparison, into = c("group1", "group2"), sep = "-") %>%
    rename(p.adj = `p adj`, p.adj.signif = `p adj`)
  test_used    <- "ANOVA + TukeyHSD"

} else {
  # Kruskal-Wallis + Dunn
  kw_result  <- kruskal_test(GMWI2 ~ Population, data = df)
  cat("\nUsing: Kruskal-Wallis\n")
  print(kw_result)

  dunn       <- dunn_test(df, GMWI2 ~ Population, p.adjust.method = "BH")
  write_xlsx(dunn,
             file.path(output_dir, paste0(prefix, "GMWI2_Kruskal_Dunn_BH.xlsx")))
  pairwise_results <- dunn
  test_used    <- "Kruskal-Wallis + Dunn (BH)"
}

cat("Test used:", test_used, "\n")
```

## 5. Annotated Boxplot with Significance

```{r boxplot-sig, fig.width=8, fig.height=7}
stat_sig <- pairwise_results %>%
  filter(p.adj.signif != "ns")

p_sig <- p_box +
  stat_pvalue_manual(stat_sig,
                     label       = "p.adj.signif",
                     y.position  = max(df$GMWI2, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.05,
                     step.increase = 0.08,
                     tip.length  = 0.01,
                     hide.ns     = TRUE)

print(p_sig)
ggsave(file.path(output_dir, paste0(prefix, "GMWI2_boxplot_by_population_sig.png")),
       p_sig, width = 7, height = 7, dpi = 300)
```
